verdict.rationale: Brex documents issuing both physical and virtual Mastercard cards and creating virtual cards instantly or in one click, with bulk issuance examples. Spend controls are documented through the Budgets/Spend Limits API, monthly user limits, and auto-enforced limits, and a community user praises the dynamic card generator. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that each individual card carries its own limit (the documented limits are per-user or per-budget), evidence that physical cards can be issued in minutes, and independent hands-on corroboration of the issuance flow.
